mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; concurrent use risks serotonin syndrome due to sertraline's SERT inhibition combined with isocarboxazid's irreversible MAOI mechanism preventing serotonin metabolism.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together or within 14 days of sertraline discontinuation; allow 2-week washout before starting MAOI after sertraline cessation.
